manifest.name: dsh-context-imports
manifest.description: Claude Code-style @path imports for DSH: expands @imports in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and injects the referenced files into model context at session start

bundle.text:
# dsh-context-imports bundle patch: one row, dual-face.
# The node half is the package's default export (host plugin: session-start
# ledger + pre-step injection); the browser half is served from ./client
# (dsh.client declaration in package.json) and injected into the web roster.
# The row id/name MUST equal the package name — the client-modules node half
# resolves require.resolve('<row-name>/package.json') to find the package and
# its dsh.client declaration.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-context-imports
      name: 'dsh-context-imports'

readme.text: <div align="center">

Inject the files referenced from AGENTS.md into model context at session start.

DeepSeek Harness injects AGENTS.md itself, but the `@path` references inside it stay as plain text and the model never sees them. This plugin expands those references the way Claude Code does: it reads each referenced file and adds the content to the session context.
English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md) ---

| | Without this plugin | With it |
|---|---|---|
| AGENTS.md itself | Injected by the stock agent-instructions plugin | Still injected by it, no duplication |
| `@docs/architecture.md` references | Plain text, ignored | Full file content in context |
| Nested imports | Nobody handles them | Expanded recursively, depth limited |
| After compaction | Referenced files are gone with the history | Re-injected automatically |
| Resumed sessions | May stack a second copy | Skipped when one is already present |

```text
agent/session-start (startup / resume / clear / compact) records the scene
agent/pre-step (every step) decides whether to inject
  ├─ scan the instruction files (default AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) for @path imports
  │    ├─ fenced code blocks are skipped; the path must have a file extension

The injected message is a `<system-reminder>` containing `<file path="...">` blocks and nothing else. Set `template` if you want your own framing around it.

- Expands `@path` imports recursively. Default depth is 3; import cycles and duplicates are collapsed.
- Follows the imports of every instruction file the harness loaded — including a project's AGENTS.md it picks up mid-session once the agent touches files under it.
- Triggers on new sessions, resume, clear, and after compaction. Each scene can be turned off.
- Never sends the same file twice: a file already in the model's context is left alone, and a newly loaded instruction file adds exactly its own imported files.
- Six-language settings card (zh, en, ja, fr, ru, ko) under Settings, Plugins, Plugin configuration. Every option is editable there and applies without a reload.
- Byte budgets per file and in total. Missing files are reported, never fatal.
- Uses the official API surface only: cordis events, `createUserMessage` from dsh-llm, a schemastery config, and the optional dsh-settings namespace. No feature-plugin dependencies.

| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `files` | `[]` | Extra files to inject, relative to the session working directory or absolute |
| `scanImports` | `true` | Scan AGENTS.md and the other instruction files for @imports |
| `instructionFiles` | `["AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md"]` | Files to scan. They are never re-injected themselves |
| `expandLoadedInstructions` | `true` | Also follow the imports of the instruction files the harness itself loaded, including a project AGENTS.md it brought in mid-session |
| `maxDepth` | `3` | How many levels of nested imports to follow |
| `maxFileBytes` | `65536` | Per-file cap in bytes; larger files are truncated |
| `maxTotalBytes` | `131072` | Total budget; files beyond it are skipped with a note |
| `injectOn` | all four | Which session-start scenes trigger injection |
| `liveMode` | `off` | Live mode for changed files: `off` (same as 0.3.1) / `inject` (re-inject on next interaction) / `inject+wake` (wake an idle agent right away) |
| `watchDebounceMs` | `30000` | Debounce window for file-change events |
| `minReinjectIntervalMs` | `300000` | Minimum interval between re-injections of the same file (churn throttle) |
| `template` | `""`

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context-imports
```

It works with no configuration: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are scanned and their imports injected. To build from source instead:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ciskonc/dsh-context-imports.git
cd dsh-context-imports
npm install
DSH_CHECKOUT=<path-to-your-dsh-installation> npm run build

| Plugin version | DeepSeek Harness | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **0.3.1+** | **≥ 0.2.0-rc.1**（0.3.1 tested on 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3） | Current line. Adds `expandLoadedInstructions`: the imports of every instruction file the harness loaded are expanded, including a project AGENTS.md it brings in mid-session. Injection is incremental — a file already in the context is never sent twice. Needs the host's published instruction scopes (`agent-instructions` message source + `agent.inbox.nextStep`), so it targets DSH ≥ 0.2.0 |
| 0.3.0 | ≥ 0.2.0-rc.1（tested on 0.2.1-rc.2） | Same feature, but the inbox lookup read `session.inbox` instead of `agent.inbox` and therefore never fired — the step-batch path carried the feature on its own. Fixed in 0.3.1 |
| 0.2.3 | ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1（tested on 0.2.0-rc.1, 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2） | Config access hardened: on DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 the volatile config projection no longer fills schema defaults, so every field is normalized at entry (0.2.2 could crash session creation or silently skip injection there). Note: on DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 install via `dsh plugin add` only — the loader verifies lockfile consistency, hand-copied node_modules are silently dropped |
| 0.2
Each release note names the DSH version it was tested against.

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Host side: session-start ledger, import expansion, budgets, pre-step injection, settings namespace |
| `src/client/index.ts` | Browser side: six-language dictionaries and the settings card slot |
| `src/client/form.ts` | Staged form model behind the card |
| `src/client/ContextImportsCard.tsx` | The card component |

<div align="center">

在会话启动时，把 AGENTS.md 里引用的文件注入模型上下文。

DSH 自带的 agent-instructions 插件会注入 AGENTS.md 本体，但里面的 `@路径` 引用只是普通文本，模型看不到。这个插件按 Claude Code 的方式处理这些引用：把每个被引用的文件读出来，加进会话上下文。
[English](README.md) | 中文 ---

| | 没有这个插件 | 装上之后 |
|---|---|---|
| AGENTS.md 本体 | 由官方 agent-instructions 注入 | 仍由它注入，不重复 |
| `@docs/architecture.md` 这类引用 | 普通文本，被忽略 | 文件全文进入上下文 |
| 引用里还有引用 | 没人处理 | 递归展开，深度可控 |
| 上下文压缩之后 | 被引用的文件随历史一起消失 | 自动重新注入 |
| 恢复旧会话 | 可能叠出第二份 | 检测到已有注入就跳过 |

```text
agent/session-start（新会话 / 恢复 / 清空 / 压缩后）记录场景
agent/pre-step（每一步）决定是否注入
  ├─ 扫描指令文件（默认 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md）里的 @路径 引用
  │    ├─ 跳过围栏代码块；路径必须带文件扩展名

注入的消息是一个 `<system-reminder>`，里面只有 `<file path="...">` 块，没有别的说明文字。想自定义包装格式就配置 `template`。

- 递归展开 `@路径` 引用。默认深度 3 层，循环引用和重复路径会自动合并。
- 跟随 DSH 已加载的所有指令文件里的引用——包括 AI 碰到项目文件后、会话中途自动带进来的项目 AGENTS.md。
- 四种场景都会触发：新会话、恢复、清空、压缩后。每种场景都可以单独关掉。
- 同一个文件不会进两次上下文：已经在模型里的文件不再重复；中途新加载的说明书只补上它自己引用的那些文件。
- 设置卡片支持六种语言（中、英、日、法、俄、韩），在 Settings 的 Plugins 页。所有配置都能在卡片上改，改完立即生效，不用重启。
- 单文件和总量都有字节上限。文件缺失只是提示，不会导致失败。
- 只用官方公开 API：cordis 事件、dsh-llm 的 `createUserMessage`、schemastery 配置校验、可选的 dsh-settings 命名空间。不依赖其他功能插件。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `files` | `[]` | 额外注入的文件，相对会话工作目录或绝对路径 |
| `scanImports` | `true` | 扫描 AGENTS.md 等指令文件里的 @import |
| `instructionFiles` | `["AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md"]` | 参与扫描的文件。它们本身不会被重复注入 |
| `expandLoadedInstructions` | `true` | 同时跟随 DSH 实际加载的其它指令文件里的引用，包括会话中途自动带进来的项目 AGENTS.md |
| `maxDepth` | `3` | 嵌套引用最多跟几层 |
| `maxFileBytes` | `65536` | 单文件字节上限，超出截断 |
| `maxTotalBytes` | `131072` | 总字节预算，放不下的文件跳过并标注 |
| `injectOn` | 全部四项 | 哪些会话启动场景触发注入 |
| `liveMode` | `off` | 文件变更的实时模式：`off`（同 0.3.1）/ `inject`（变更后下次交互补发）/ `inject+wake`（空闲会话立即唤醒重注入） |
| `watchDebounceMs` | `30000` | 文件变更事件的防抖窗口 |
| `minReinjectIntervalMs` | `300000` | 同一文件两次重注入的最小间隔（防频繁改写刷屏） |
| `template` | `""` | 自定义包装文本。`{{content}}` 标记文件内容的位置；留空用默认格式 |

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context-imports
```

装完不用配置就能用：默认扫描 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md，并把引用到的文件注入会话。想从源码构建：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ciskonc/dsh-context-imports.git
cd dsh-context-imports
npm install
DSH_CHECKOUT=<你的 dsh 安装目录> npm run build

| 插件版本 | DeepSeek Harness | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| **0.3.1+** | **≥ 0.2.0-rc.1**（0.3.1 实测 0.2.1-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.3） | 当前线。新增 `expandLoadedInstructions`：展开 DSH 已加载的所有指令文件里的引用，包括会话中途自动带进来的项目 AGENTS.md；注入改为增量式——已在上下文里的文件不再重复发送。依赖宿主发布的指令作用域信息（`agent-instructions` 消息 source + `agent.inbox.nextStep`），故面向 DSH ≥ 0.2.0 |
| 0.3.0 | ≥ 0.2.0-rc.1（实测 0.2.1-rc.2） | 同一功能，但 inbox 取值读成了 `session.inbox`（应为 `agent.inbox`），那条路径从未生效——实际靠「本轮消息批次」路径撑起。0.3.1 已修 |
| 0.2.3 | ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1（实测 0.2.0-rc.1、0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2） | 配置读取加固：DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 起 volatile 配置投影不再填充 schema 默认值，入口处对全部字段归一化（0.2.2 在该版本上可能崩溃会话创建或静默不注入）。注意：DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 起只能用 `dsh plugin add` 安装——loader 会校验 lockfile 一致性，手拷 node_modules 会被静默丢弃 |
| 0.2.0 – 0.2.2 | ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1（0.2.1 实测 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.0-rc.1；0.2.2 实测 0.2.0-rc.1） | 0.2.2 修复压缩后不重注入与设置页挂载，但在 DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 上可能崩溃会话创建（`injectOn.includes is not a function`）或静默不注入（`cfg.files is not iterable`）——请升级 0.2.3 |
| 0.1.x | 0.1.5-rc.1 – 0.1.5-rc.3（实测 0.1.5-rc.2/rc.3） | 旧线。**不支持 0.1.7**——它依赖已被移除的 `settingsScope` 服务和 `agent/session-start` 事件 |
每个 Release 的说明里会注明当时测试所用的 DSH 版本。

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Host 端：会话场景记账、引用展开、预算、pre-step 注入、设置命名空间 |
| `src/client/index.ts` | 浏览器端：六语言字典和设置卡片 |
| `src/client/form.ts` | 卡片背后的暂存表单模型 |
| `src/client/ContextImportsCard.tsx` | 卡片组件 |
